description: Read a PDF, a CSV, a TSV or a saved paste on this machine into rows, and say what the reading cannot vouch for. Returns the cut into columns, what each column holds, the rows numbered for check_citations, and the doubts. An empty list of doubts is NOT a promise that the reading is right: it means nothing looked wrong from the shape of the page. The file is read on this machine and never uploaded.

digest.description: The digest read_table returned for this file. When given, the call is refused if the file has changed since: its rows would no longer be the ones numbered.

from.description: First row to return, 1 for the start. Rows keep these numbers.

limit.description: Rows to return, at most 2000. Defaults to 200. What is left is counted and named, never silently dropped.

maximumPages.description: How many pages to open. Defaults to 40, which bounds a runaway read rather than describing your document: raise it for an annual report.

path.description: Absolute path to the file on this machine. It is read here and never uploaded.

name: read_table

reason.description: Why the file did not open, when the library could tell: empty, too-big, no-text, too-slow, or the kind of bytes it was. Only on an unreadable verdict.

title: Read a table out of a document
